name: Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd
about: Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd (HAL), a 71.64% Government-owned Maha-Ratna CPSE, designs, manufactures, upgrades and provides lifecycle MRO for aircraft, helicopters, aero -engines, avionics /accessories and aerostructures, principally for India’s armed forces.[1]
keyPoints: Business Segments 1) Manufacturing The five-complex model covers: 1) Fixed-wing aircraft: LCA Tejas, Su-30MKI, Do/Hindustan-228, HTT-40 and legacy fleets 2) ⁠Helicopters: ALH/Dhruv-NG, LCH, LUH, Cheetah/Chetak and future IMRH/DBMRH 3) AL-31FP, RD-33 and Shakti engines 4) Avionics, LRUs and accessories 5) Aerostructures, castings and forgings 6) Aircraft, rotorcraft, UAV, engine and airborne-system R&D[1]
pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 26.0%
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 31.9%
cons: Stock is trading at 7.23 times its book value
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 7.78% over past five years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.4,087 Cr.
Working capital days have increased from 153 days to 301 days

announcements.text: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Change in Management 13 Nov - Shri Shrirang Anilrao Kothe appointed CEO of Helicopter Complex on 13 November 2026.
Audited Financial Results (Standalone And Consolidated) For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30Th September, 2026 12 Nov
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Credit Rating 11 Nov - ICRA withdrew HAL’s ratings on 11 Nov 2026 for ₹6,050 crore facilities.
General Updates 3 Nov - HAL to acquire CAE Canada’s 50% stake in HATSOFF, making it wholly-owned subsidiary.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Change in Directorate 28 Oct - HAL appointed P B Rangarao as Director (Operations) from 28 Oct 2026; Kota Ravi ceased additional charge.
